sentences.en: Aliens prevented a major war on Earth by hidden manipulation.
sentences.zh: 外星人通过隐秘的操纵阻止了地球上的大规模战争。

sentences.en: They like to manipulate, but their manipulations don't have desired results.
sentences.zh: 他们喜欢操控他人，但他们的操控并没有达到预期的效果。

sentences.en: The Bouteflika years were characterized by electoral manipulation.
sentences.zh: 布特弗利卡执政时期的特点是选举舞弊。

senses.zh: (熟练的)操作；操纵；控制 - (对账目等的)伪造，篡改
